ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch and peduncle interface region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central black wedge-shaped pigmentation extending from the median notch toward the lower peduncle. Lateral lobes are predominantly high-intensity white with sparse, dark focal mottling (approximately 2-5 pixels in diameter) localized in the lower quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the trailing boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) across the mid-lobe, transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged irregularities at the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, showing a smooth sweep from the central notch to the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters on the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring. Small dark circular clusters visible on the lower-left ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct curvilinear dark mark (rake or scratch) approximately 15 pixels in length located on the inner right lobe at the boundary of the black-to-white pigmentation transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable erosion and irregular pixel-level fragmentation of the trailing edge boundary at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
